title: Back To The Grave
description: By adding this mod to your game you can find coordinates of the place you died on.
body: **BACK TO THE GRAVE**:This is a simple mod that will just make finding your lost inventory back when you die in your survival world by giving you the coordinates of were you died.I will work hard to improve your survival and make it full of adventure but i need your's support, without your's supprt it is not possible.
